principle: Only official or first-party public sources can become recommendation records.

sources.name: Devpost
sources.notes: Public directory is authoritative for hosted hackathons. Records must be re-verified on the individual organizer page before publication.

sources.name: Kaggle Competitions
sources.notes: Competition directory is first-party. Records must retain the official competition URL and pass the same checkpoint.

blocked_sources: social media posts as sole evidence
publish_rule: A source can discover a candidate, but a candidate is publishable only after the server checkpoint passes with an official source URL, verification timestamp, open status, usable deadline and non-empty eligibility evidence.
